The two tools that list your activities were sending ninety per cent padding.
No tool was added or removed — the server still declares 109.

## A hundred activities did not fit in a response

`list_recent_activities` and `get_activities_by_date` handed back the activity
list service payload exactly as it arrives. That is about 3,800 characters per
activity, and the metrics are a tenth of it. The rest, repeated on every single
activity:

```
userRoles           thirty OAuth scope strings
profile images      the same three URLs, every time
summarizedDiveInfo  {"summarizedDiveGases":[]}
```

Asking for a hundred activities — the maximum the tool documents — produced
around 94,000 tokens, far past the limit for a single tool result, so nothing
came back at all.

Both tools now return the summary the comparison tools already work from: id,
name, type, date, distance, duration, speed, heart rate, calories, elevation,
steps and training effect.

```
limit 3     2,877 tokens  ->    339
limit 20   19,115 tokens  ->  2,183
limit 100  94,288 tokens  -> 10,182
```

`includeDetails: true` still returns the payload untouched, the same opt-in the
sleep and badge tools use.

## A date range had no ceiling at all

`get_activities_by_date` paged until Garmin ran out of activities. Eight months
of this account is 387 of them: ~38,000 tokens even summarised, and a full year
would simply not return.

It now lists at most `limit` activities — 100 by default, 200 at the top — and
when the range holds more it says so instead of passing off the first hundred as
the whole range. `count_activities` still gives the total without listing
anything.

## What was deliberately left uncapped

`get_progress_summary` and `analyze_training_period` aggregate over a range, so
they read it whole. A total computed over a truncated range is wrong without
saying so, which is precisely the bug fixed in v4.3.0, where
`get_progress_summary` was quietly working from the last hundred activities.

Both still report 387 activities over the eight-month range, matching
`count_activities`, with the type breakdown adding up: 215 walks, 86 indoor
rides, 86 strength sessions.

## Install

Download `garmin-mcp-ts.mcpb` and open it with Claude Desktop, or drag it onto
Settings → Extensions. Verify the download first:

```
sha256sum -c garmin-mcp-ts.mcpb.sha256
```

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/sedoglia/garmin-mcp-ts/compare/v4.5.6...v4.5.7
